transformations: Converted the existing JSON array to JSON Lines.
Mapped draw identifiers, dates, and selected numbers to canonical field names.
Split the seven-number draw-order array into front and back order fields without reordering it.
Preserved legacy equipment and promotion flags with explicit legacy suffixes.
Converted monetary JSON numbers to decimal strings to avoid further binary-float arithmetic.
Preserved original prize labels, amounts, counts, totals, and conditions as separate rows.
known_limitations: This is already-cleaned data, not immutable raw official API responses.
The original cleaning script uses bool(lotteryPromotionFlag); source field type was not retained, so promotion flags require raw-source reconciliation.
The original cleaning script contains a no-op awardType condition and retained all prize rows; labels are preserved without reinterpretation.
1,398 draws have no sales value; 560 draws have no draw-order value.
Equipment code 0 is treated as unknown, not as a real equipment identity.
21 draws contain promotion prize rows where amount is 0 but total is positive; these require source-level interpretation.
This candidate must not be used as a trusted predictive training set until official-source reconciliation and rule-era checks are complete.
